topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I just found out that the place where I've spent countless evenings, where the walls know my name and the tables bear the marks of my countless meals—well, it’s going to close. They said the lease expired, and the owner can't afford to renew it. It’s like a punch in the gut. I’ve tried all the new places, but none of them make the sauce like they do. I don’t even know how to cook it myself; I’ve always relied on them. I guess I should go there one last time, eat all my favorites, and say goodbye to a place that was more than just a restaurant.
